doc.title: Scoring Guide
doc.introduction: This guide explains the scoring scale used to rate every boule. The goal is to produce consistent and comparable statistics across all players.

why.title: Why rate boules?
why.text: The application does not judge a player's technical ability. It measures the actual impact of every boule on the end in order to generate meaningful statistics.

commonScale.title: A shared scoring scale
commonScale.text: For statistics to be meaningful, every player should use the same scale. With a little practice, rating boules becomes quick and natural.

minus2.title: 🟥 -2 · Harmful boule
minus2.description: The boule clearly makes the situation worse for your team.
minus2.example1: A point that pushes one of your own boules away.
minus2.example2: A missed shot that completely opens the game for the opponents.
minus2.example3: Any boule that causes your team to lose a significant advantage.
minus2.summary: A -2 boule clearly hurts your team.

minus1.title: 🟧 -1 · Useless boule
minus1.description: The boule brings no benefit to your team.
minus1.example2: A point far too long or too short.
minus1.example3: A boule that is completely out of play.
minus1.example4: A missed shot with no real consequence.
minus1.summary: The boule provides no useful contribution.

zero.title: ⚪ 0 · Average boule
zero.description: The boule has only a limited impact on the end.
zero.example1: A point that is fairly close but not good enough.
zero.example3: A boule that applies some pressure without really changing the game.
zero.summary: The boule has only a minor influence.

plus1.title: 🟩 +1 · Good boule
plus1.summary: A solid boule that does exactly what was expected.

plus2.title: 🟦 +2 · Outstanding boule
plus2.description: The boule gives your team a major advantage.
plus2.example3: A blocker that completely locks the game.
plus2.example4: Any boule that dramatically changes the outcome of the end.
plus2.summary: A +2 boule has a much greater impact than an ordinary good boule.

carreau.title: Is a carreau always worth +2?
carreau.answer: No. The rating always depends on the boule's actual impact. Most carreaux deserve +2, but a very easy or low-impact shot may simply be rated +1.

palet.title: Is a palet worth +2?
palet.answer: No. A palet is usually rated +1 because it perfectly achieves its objective. It only deserves +2 when it provides an exceptional advantage.

firstPoint.title: Can the first point of an end be worth +2?
firstPoint.answer: Yes. A first point that is almost impossible to beat or that immediately locks the end may deserve +2. A simply good first point remains +1.

difficulty.title: Is the difficulty of the throw taken into account?
difficulty.answer: No. The rating does not measure technical difficulty. It only measures the value the boule brings to the team when it is played.

beautiful.title: Can a technically beautiful boule receive a low rating?
beautiful.answer: Yes. A technically impressive boule with little real impact may receive an average rating. On the other hand, a less spectacular boule may deserve +2 if its impact is exceptional.

philosophy.title: The philosophy behind the system
philosophy.text1: A rating does not reward a beautiful throw. It only measures the value the boule brings to the team.
philosophy.text2: When everyone uses the same scale, statistics become comparable between players and across matches.
philosophy.quote: Don't ask yourself whether the boule was beautiful. Ask yourself how much it brought to your team.
